_comment: Which object in props.glb becomes which prop in the game.
The key is the OBJECT NAME in Blender. Name an object after a prop type -- pine, fir, birch,
rock, boulder, rail, hut, lamp, sign, snowman, fence -- and it is picked up with no entry here
at all; a trailing .001 or _2 is ignored, so pine, pine.001 and pine_2 are three variants of
the same prop and the game will spread them across the forest. This file exists for exports
that still have Blender's default names in them.
`height` is what the object should measure from its base to its top, in metres, at scale 1.
The loader scales it uniformly to that and sits its base on y=0, so how big you modelled it
does not matter -- only its proportions do.
